entries.example: I have a cat and an umbrella at home.
entries.exampleZh: 我家裡有一隻貓和一把雨傘。

cloze.sentence: My brother is ___ engineer in a big company in Taipei.
cloze.fullSentence: My brother is a/an engineer in a big company in Taipei.
cloze.translation: 我哥哥是台北一家大公司的工程師。

clozeEasy.sentence: There is ___ big banyan tree in our school yard.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: There is a/an big banyan tree in our school yard.
clozeEasy.translation: 我們學校操場上有一棵大榕樹。
clozeEasy.clue: 單數可數名詞、第一次提到

clozeEasy.sentence: She wants to be ___ artist when she grows up.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: She wants to be a/an artist when she grows up.
clozeEasy.translation: 她長大後想成為一名畫家。

clozeMedium.sentence: We waited for ___ hour outside the busy train station.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: We waited for a/an hour outside the busy train station.
clozeMedium.translation: 我們在忙碌的火車站外等了一個小時。

clozeMedium.sentence: My uncle bought ___ new scooter last weekend.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: My uncle bought a/an new scooter last weekend.
clozeMedium.translation: 我叔叔上週末買了一輛新的機車。

clozeHard.sentence: ___ honest answer is better than a pretty lie.
clozeHard.fullSentence: a/an honest answer is better than a pretty lie.
clozeHard.translation: 誠實的回答比美麗的謊言更好。
clozeHard.clue: 單數、第一次提到的不定冠詞

entries.example: All the students in my class joined the science club.
entries.exampleZh: 我班上所有學生都加入了科學社。

cloze.sentence: ___ three of my cousins came to our family dinner last night.
cloze.fullSentence: all three of my cousins came to our family dinner last night.
cloze.translation: 我的三個表哥妹昨晚全都來參加家庭聚餐了。

clozeEasy.sentence: ___ of the milk is gone, so please buy some more.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: all of the milk is gone, so please buy some more.
clozeEasy.translation: 牛奶全部喝完了，請再買一些。

clozeEasy.sentence: There were fifty questions on the test, and ___ of my answers were right.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: There were fifty questions on the test, and all of my answers were right.
clozeEasy.translation: 考試有五十題，我的答案全部都對。

clozeMedium.sentence: ___ of the thirty students in my class passed the final exam; nobody failed.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: all of the thirty students in my class passed the final exam; nobody failed.
clozeMedium.translation: 我所有同學都通過了期末考；沒有人不及格。

clozeMedium.sentence: ___ the water in the pool evaporated during the hot week.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: all the water in the pool evaporated during the hot week.
clozeMedium.translation: 炎熱的那一週，泳池裡的水全部蒸發了。

clozeHard.sentence: The teacher collected ___ of the exam papers before the bell rang, and not a single one was left on the desks.
clozeHard.fullSentence: The teacher collected all of the exam papers before the bell rang, and not a single one was left on the desks.
clozeHard.translation: 老師在鐘響前收齐了所有的考卷，桌上一張都不剩。

entries.example: This cookie is delicious. Can I have another one?
entries.exampleZh: 這塊餅乾真好吃。我可以再來一塊嗎？

cloze.sentence: This shirt is too small for me. Please show me ___ one in a bigger size.
cloze.fullSentence: This shirt is too small for me. Please show me another one in a bigger size.
cloze.translation: 這件襯衫我穿太小了。請給我看另一件大一點的。

clozeEasy.sentence: I finished this novel, so my dad bought me ___ one yesterday.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: I finished this novel, so my dad bought me another one yesterday.
clozeEasy.translation: 我讀完了這本小說，所以爸爸昨天又買了一本給我。

clozeEasy.sentence: The song was so beautiful that we asked the singer to sing ___ one.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: The song was so beautiful that we asked the singer to sing another one.
clozeEasy.translation: 這首歌太好聽了，所以我們請歌手再唱一首。

clozeMedium.sentence: One of my shoes broke, so I have to buy ___ pair tomorrow.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: One of my shoes broke, so I have to buy another pair tomorrow.
clozeMedium.translation: 我的一隻鞋壞了，所以我明天得再買一雙。
clozeMedium.clue: 壞了一隻 → 再買一雙

clozeMedium.sentence: Can I ask you ___ question after this one?
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Can I ask you another question after this one?
clozeMedium.translation: 這題之後我可以再問你一個問題嗎？

clozeHard.sentence: The fast finishers got ___ worksheet to try while the others were still writing.
clozeHard.fullSentence: The fast finishers got another worksheet to try while the others were still writing.
clozeHard.translation: 先寫完的人拿到另一張學習單來練習，其他人還在寫。

entries.zh: 任何；一些（用於否定句與疑問句）
entries.example: Do you have any questions about today's lesson?
entries.exampleZh: 你對今天的課程有任何問題嗎？

cloze.sentence: I do not have ___ brothers or sisters, so I often play with my cousins.
cloze.fullSentence: I do not have any brothers or sisters, so I often play with my cousins.
cloze.translation: 我沒有兄弟姊妹，所以我常和表兄妹一起玩。

clozeEasy.sentence: Are there ___ seats left for the movie tonight?
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Are there any seats left for the movie tonight?
clozeEasy.translation: 今晚的電影還有座位嗎？

clozeEasy.sentence: There is not ___ milk left in the refrigerator.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: There is not any milk left in the refrigerator.
clozeEasy.translation: 冰箱裡一點牛奶都不剩了。

clozeMedium.sentence: We do not have ___ classes tomorrow afternoon, so let us play basketball.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: We do not have any classes tomorrow afternoon, so let us play basketball.
clozeMedium.translation: 我們明天下午沒有任何課，所以我們來打籃球吧。

clozeMedium.sentence: You can borrow ___ two books you like from my bookshelf.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: You can borrow any two books you like from my bookshelf.
clozeMedium.translation: 你可以從我的書架上借你喜歡的任何兩本書。

clozeHard.sentence: Hardly ___ of the students knew the answer to the last question on the math test.
clozeHard.fullSentence: Hardly any of the students knew the answer to the last question on the math test.
clozeHard.translation: 數學考卷最後一題，幾乎沒有學生知道答案。

entries.example: Did anybody see my glasses on the desk?
entries.exampleZh: 有人看到我的眼鏡在桌上嗎？

cloze.sentence: The hallway was completely empty; I did not meet ___ on my way to the office.
cloze.fullSentence: The hallway was completely empty; I did not meet anybody on my way to the office.
cloze.translation: 體育館空空的；我完全沒有看到任何人。

clozeEasy.sentence: I don't think there is ___ in this classroom who can lift this heavy piano by himself.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: I don't think there is anybody in this classroom who can lift this heavy piano by himself.
clozeEasy.translation: 我認為這間教室裡沒有人能獨自搬起這台沉重的鋼琴。
clozeEasy.clue: 否定句、後面接 who 指人

clozeEasy.sentence: If ___ calls for me, please tell them I am in the library.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: If anybody calls for me, please tell them I am in the library.
clozeEasy.translation: 如果有人找我，請告訴他們我在圖書館。

clozeMedium.sentence: I did not invite ___ to the surprise party, so our teacher really had no idea.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: I did not invite anybody to the surprise party, so our teacher really had no idea.
clozeMedium.translation: 我沒有告訴任何人關於我們老師的驚喜派對。

clozeMedium.sentence: The new museum is hard to find; hardly ___ knows the way there.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The new museum is hard to find; hardly anybody knows the way there.
clozeMedium.translation: 有人知道市中心那座新博物館怎麼走嗎？

clozeHard.sentence: The math problem was so difficult that hardly ___ in the class could solve it.
clozeHard.fullSentence: The math problem was so difficult that hardly anybody in the class could solve it.
clozeHard.translation: 這道數學題太難了，班上幾乎沒有人會解。

entries.example: Has anyone finished the science homework yet?
entries.exampleZh: 有人已經寫完科學功課了嗎？

cloze.sentence: I do not think ___ will argue with such a fair plan.
cloze.fullSentence: I do not think anyone will argue with such a fair plan.
cloze.translation: 我不認為會有人反對這麼公平的計畫。

clozeEasy.sentence: I do not think ___ in our class can speak Japanese, so let us ask Mr. Lin.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: I do not think anyone in our class can speak Japanese, so let us ask Mr. Lin.
clozeEasy.translation: 這裡有人會說一點日語嗎？

clozeEasy.sentence: Is there ___ in this class who cannot swim at all?
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Is there anyone in this class who cannot swim at all?
clozeEasy.translation: 如果有人需要鉛筆，我桌上有一些。

clozeMedium.sentence: The guard did not question ___ near the school gate last night.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The guard did not question anyone near the school gate last night.
clozeMedium.translation: 想參加合唱團的人要在星期五前報名。

clozeMedium.sentence: I have not met ___ from Canada before, so I have many questions.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: I have not met anyone from Canada before, so I have many questions.
clozeMedium.translation: 我以前沒見過加拿大來的人，所以我有好多問題。

clozeHard.sentence: The secret stayed safe because ___ who knew about it promised not to tell.
clozeHard.fullSentence: The secret stayed safe because anyone who knew about it promised not to tell.
clozeHard.translation: 祕密保住了，因為每個知道的人（任何人）都答應不說出去。

entries.zh: 任何事物（疑問句、否定句）
entries.example: Is there anything good on TV tonight?
entries.exampleZh: 今晚電視有什麼好看的節目嗎？

cloze.sentence: My grandmother cannot eat ___ sweet because of her health.
cloze.fullSentence: My grandmother cannot eat anything sweet because of her health.
cloze.translation: 因為健康因素，我奶奶不能吃任何甜的東西。

clozeEasy.sentence: I did not buy ___ at the night market last night because it started to rain.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: I did not buy anything at the night market last night because it started to rain.
clozeEasy.translation: 你昨晚在夜市有買什麼東西嗎？

clozeEasy.sentence: There is not ___ in my lunch box because I forgot it at home.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: There is not anything in my lunch box because I forgot it at home.
clozeEasy.translation: 我的便當盒裡什麼都沒有，因為忘在家裡了。

clozeMedium.sentence: You may order ___ you like on the menu; it is my treat today.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: You may order anything you like on the menu; it is my treat today.
clozeMedium.translation: 菜單上你喜歡的都可以點；今天我請客。

clozeMedium.sentence: I could not find ___ about that history topic in the school library.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: I could not find anything about that history topic in the school library.
clozeMedium.translation: 在學校圖書館我找不到任何關於那個歷史主題的資料。

clozeHard.sentence: The detective said that ___ could have happened that night, so he had to check every clue twice.
clozeHard.fullSentence: The detective said that anything could have happened that night, so he had to check every clue twice.
clozeHard.translation: 偵探說那晚什麼事都可能發生，所以每條線索都得查兩遍。

entries.example: Both of my parents are teachers.
entries.exampleZh: 我的父母都是老師。

cloze.sentence: I have two best friends, and ___ of them live near my house.
cloze.fullSentence: I have two best friends, and both of them live near my house.
cloze.translation: 我有兩個最好的朋友，他們兩個都住在我家附近。

clozeEasy.sentence: ___ answers are correct, so you can choose either one.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: both answers are correct, so you can choose either one.
clozeEasy.translation: 兩個答案都對，所以你可以任選一個。

clozeEasy.sentence: There are two cakes on the table, and ___ of them look delicious.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: There are two cakes on the table, and both of them look delicious.
clozeEasy.translation: 桌上有兩個蛋糕，兩個看起來都很好吃。

clozeMedium.sentence: My brother and I ___ love playing basketball after school.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: My brother and I both love playing basketball after school.
clozeMedium.translation: 我和哥哥放學後都愛打籃球。

clozeMedium.sentence: The twins ___ enjoy reading detective novels before bed.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The twins both enjoy reading detective novels before bed.
clozeMedium.translation: 這對雙胞胎睡前都喜歡讀偵探小說。

clozeHard.sentence: Of the two routes to the beach, ___ are usually busy on weekends, so we left early in the morning.
clozeHard.fullSentence: Of the two routes to the beach, both are usually busy on weekends, so we left early in the morning.
clozeHard.translation: 去海灘的兩條路，週末通常都很擠，所以我們一大早就出發。

entries.zh: 每個（兩個或以上，逐一分開看）
entries.example: Each student has a different answer to this riddle.
entries.exampleZh: 每個學生對這個謎語都有不同的答案。

cloze.sentence: ___ player on the team gets a medal after winning the game.
cloze.fullSentence: each player on the team gets a medal after winning the game.
cloze.translation: 贏得比賽後，隊上每個球員都得到一面獎牌。
cloze.clue: 逐一發給每一個、單數動詞

clozeEasy.sentence: There are four seasons, and ___ season has its own beauty.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: There are four seasons, and each season has its own beauty.
clozeEasy.translation: 有四個季節，每個季節都有各自的美。

clozeEasy.sentence: ___ morning I drink a glass of warm water before breakfast.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: each morning I drink a glass of warm water before breakfast.
clozeEasy.translation: 每天早上我早餐前喝一杯溫水。

clozeMedium.sentence: The teacher gave ___ of us a different topic for the speech.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The teacher gave each of us a different topic for the speech.
clozeMedium.translation: 老師給我們每個人不同的演講題目。
clozeMedium.clue: 題目各不相同 → 逐一

clozeMedium.sentence: ___ of the two bridges has a bike lane for riders.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: each of the two bridges has a bike lane for riders.
clozeMedium.translation: 兩座橋各有一條自行車道。
clozeMedium.clue: 兩座橋逐一、單數動詞 has

clozeHard.sentence: There are twelve zodiac animals, and ___ one takes a turn every year in order.
clozeHard.fullSentence: There are twelve zodiac animals, and each one takes a turn every year in order.
clozeHard.translation: 十二生肖輪流，每個動物依序每年值一年。

entries.zh: 每一；每個（強調全體，動詞單數）
entries.example: Every student must wear a uniform at our school.
entries.exampleZh: 每個學生都必須穿制服。

cloze.sentence: ___ morning, the mail carrier delivers letters on our street.
cloze.fullSentence: every morning, the mail carrier delivers letters on our street.
cloze.translation: 每天早上，郵差在我們街上送信。

clozeEasy.sentence: ___ student in the class passed the spelling test this time.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: every student in the class passed the spelling test this time.
clozeEasy.translation: 這次班上每個學生都通過了拼字測驗。

clozeEasy.sentence: The library is open ___ day of the week except Monday.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: The library is open every day of the week except Monday.
clozeEasy.translation: 圖書館除了週一，每天開放。

clozeMedium.sentence: ___ time I visit Grandma, she bakes my favorite cookies.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: every time I visit Grandma, she bakes my favorite cookies.
clozeMedium.translation: 每次我去看奶奶，她都會烤我最愛的餅乾。

clozeMedium.sentence: The bus to the museum leaves ___ hour, so we will not wait long.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The bus to the museum leaves every hour, so we will not wait long.
clozeMedium.translation: 往博物館的公車每小時一班，所以我們不用等太久。

clozeHard.sentence: Almost ___ corner of the old market sells something different, from toys to tea.
clozeHard.fullSentence: Almost every corner of the old market sells something different, from toys to tea.
clozeHard.translation: 老市場幾乎每個角落賣的東西都不一樣，從玩具到茶葉都有。

entries.example: Everybody in our family enjoys watching baseball games together.
entries.exampleZh: 我們家每個人都喜歡一起看棒球比賽。

cloze.sentence: ___ was excited when the school announced a free field trip.
cloze.fullSentence: everybody was excited when the school announced a free field trip.
cloze.translation: 學校宣布免費校外教學時，大家都很興奮。

clozeEasy.sentence: ___ loves a warm bowl of noodle soup on a cold day.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: everybody loves a warm bowl of noodle soup on a cold day.
clozeEasy.translation: 冷天裡大家都愛一碗熱騰騰的湯麵。

clozeEasy.sentence: Good morning, ___! Please take out your homework now.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Good morning, everybody! Please take out your homework now.
clozeEasy.translation: 大家早安！請現在把功課拿出來。

clozeMedium.sentence: ___ in our class brought a dish to the party; even Ken, who hates cooking, made egg tarts.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: everybody in our class brought a dish to the party; even Ken, who hates cooking, made egg tarts.
clozeMedium.translation: 班上派對時，每個人都帶了一道家裡的菜來分享。

clozeMedium.sentence: ___ in the audience stood up and clapped together at the end of the show.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: everybody in the audience stood up and clapped together at the end of the show.
clozeMedium.translation: 表演結束時，全場觀眾都起立鼓掌。

clozeHard.sentence: Almost ___ I know uses the MRT, from my little cousin to my grandfather.
clozeHard.fullSentence: Almost everybody I know uses the MRT, from my little cousin to my grandfather.
clozeHard.translation: 我認識的人幾乎都搭捷運，從我小表弟到我爺爺都是。

entries.example: Everyone in the choir sang the last song together.
entries.exampleZh: 合唱團的每個人一起唱了最後一首歌。

cloze.sentence: When the fireworks started, ___ looked up at the sky at the same time.
cloze.fullSentence: When the fireworks started, everyone looked up at the sky at the same time.
cloze.translation: 煙火開始時，每個人都同時抬頭看天空。

clozeEasy.sentence: ___ in our school, from first graders to teachers, knows Coach Chen's whistle.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: everyone in our school, from first graders to teachers, knows Coach Chen's whistle.
clozeEasy.translation: 每個人都知道熊貓是最受歡迎的動物園明星。

clozeEasy.sentence: Happy birthday, ___ is waiting for you in the living room!
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Happy birthday, everyone is waiting for you in the living room!
clozeEasy.translation: 生日快樂，大家都在客廳等你！

clozeMedium.sentence: The new student was friendly, and soon ___ in the class wanted to be her partner, even the shyest boy.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The new student was friendly, and soon everyone in the class wanted to be her partner, even the shyest boy.
clozeMedium.translation: 新同學很友善，很快每個人都想跟她一組。

clozeMedium.sentence: The coach promised that ___ who finishes the relay race gets a small bottle of juice, even the slowest runner.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The coach promised that everyone who finishes the relay race gets a small bottle of juice, even the slowest runner.
clozeMedium.translation: 跑完接力賽的每個人都會得到一小瓶果汁。

clozeHard.sentence: The teacher asked a question, and ___ raised a hand, even the quietest student in the back row.
clozeHard.fullSentence: The teacher asked a question, and everyone raised a hand, even the quietest student in the back row.
clozeHard.translation: 老師問了一個問題，每個人都舉手，連最後排最安靜的學生也是。
clozeHard.clue: 連最安靜的都舉手 → 全體

entries.example: Dad checks everything on his list before the trip.
entries.exampleZh: 爸爸出發前會檢查清單上的每一件事。

cloze.sentence: ___ in the night market smells delicious, from fried chicken to bubble tea.
cloze.fullSentence: everything in the night market smells delicious, from fried chicken to bubble tea.
cloze.translation: 夜市裡每樣東西聞起來都好香，從炸雞到珍珠奶茶。

clozeEasy.sentence: The movers packed ___ in boxes before we left the old apartment.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: The movers packed everything in boxes before we left the old apartment.
clozeEasy.translation: 搬家工人把所有東西都裝箱後，我們才離開舊公寓。

clozeEasy.sentence: ___ on the menu looks good, so I cannot decide what to order.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: everything on the menu looks good, so I cannot decide what to order.
clozeEasy.translation: 菜單上的每樣都看起來很好吃，所以我無法決定點什麼。

clozeMedium.sentence: The new robot vacuum cleaned ___ in the house, and now every corner shines.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The new robot vacuum cleaned everything in the house, and now every corner shines.
clozeMedium.translation: 新款掃地機器人可以自己清掃所有地方，連床下都行。

clozeMedium.sentence: Grandma taught me ___ I know about making dumplings.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Grandma taught me everything I know about making dumplings.
clozeMedium.translation: 我會包餃子的一切都是奶奶教我的。

clozeHard.sentence: Money cannot buy ___, like true friendship and warm memories.
clozeHard.fullSentence: Money cannot buy everything, like true friendship and warm memories.
clozeHard.translation: 金錢買不到一切，像真摯的友誼和溫暖的回憶。

entries.example: Many tourists visit the night market every weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 每個週末都有許多觀光客逛夜市。

cloze.sentence: There are ___ cherry trees along the river, and they bloom in March.
cloze.fullSentence: There are many cherry trees along the river, and they bloom in March.
cloze.translation: 河邊有許多櫻花樹，三月開花。

clozeEasy.sentence: How ___ pencils do you have in your pencil box?
clozeEasy.fullSentence: How many pencils do you have in your pencil box?
clozeEasy.translation: 你的鉛筆盒裡有幾支鉛筆？

clozeEasy.sentence: ___ people waited in line for the famous beef noodle soup.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: many people waited in line for the famous beef noodle soup.
clozeEasy.translation: 許多人排隊等那家有名的牛肉麵。

clozeMedium.sentence: Not ___ students can solve this puzzle in one minute; in fact, only two of us could last year.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Not many students can solve this puzzle in one minute; in fact, only two of us could last year.
clozeMedium.translation: 沒有多少學生能在一分鐘內解開這個謎題。

clozeMedium.sentence: ___ of the five hundred visitors take photos of the sunrise at Alishan.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: many of the five hundred visitors take photos of the sunrise at Alishan.
clozeMedium.translation: 許多遊客在阿里山拍日出的照片。

clozeHard.sentence: The museum received ___ new paintings this year, more than two hundred in total.
clozeHard.fullSentence: The museum received many new paintings this year, more than two hundred in total.
clozeHard.translation: 博物館今年收到許多新畫作，總共超過兩百幅。

entries.example: Most students in our school take the MRT to class.
entries.exampleZh: 我們學校大多數學生搭捷運上學。

cloze.sentence: ___ of my thirty classmates walk to school because it is close by.
cloze.fullSentence: most of my thirty classmates walk to school because it is close by.
cloze.translation: 我大多數同學走路上下學，因為學校很近。

clozeEasy.sentence: Lisa scored the ___ points in the tournament, so she became the MVP.
